name: Detention
_comment: The floor plan detention is built from. Run tools/maps/extrude_room.py on it and it
writes both the room's 3D model and the walkability mask, so the two cannot disagree.
Coordinates are the same ones objects.json uses: x right, y down, 0,0 at the middle of
the map. About 200 units is a metre — a desk is 190 wide, so a bit under one.
Walls are a line from one point to another. Doors and windows are 'openings': 'at' is
how far along the wall, from 0 at the start to 1 at the end.

walls._name: North — the wall the teacher's desk faces, with two windows
